answer: An AI employee is an AI agent set up to do a defined job in your business, such as answering calls, processing invoices or following up leads, using your systems and rules. Crenosoft’s AI employees are human-backed: a dedicated team reviews anything the AI is unsure about, so work is done correctly without your staff babysitting it.
body:
The problem with AI on its own

AI can now answer calls, read invoices, sort email and write follow-ups. But every business owner who has tried it knows the catch: AI handles the normal cases well and gets the unusual ones wrong. Someone has to watch it, catch the mistakes and deal with the exceptions. In most businesses that someone is already busy, so the AI either gets switched off or quietly causes problems.

The market has split into two halves. AI build agencies create custom agents and hand them over, leaving your team to supervise them. Hybrid answering services put human backup behind an AI receptionist, but only for phone calls, and their backup staff are generalists working from a script who don’t know your clients, your pricing or your rules.

Crenosoft AI Employees combine the best of both: custom AI built around your business, across front office and back office, with a dedicated team that knows your business checking the work.

How human-backed AI employees work

  1. We build your AI employee around one job, using your systems, your knowledge and your rules.
  2. The AI does the routine work: the calls, emails, documents and follow-ups that follow a normal pattern.
  3. Exceptions go to your Crenosoft team. Anything unclear, unusual, sensitive or low-confidence is routed to a trained reviewer assigned to your account.
  4. The reviewer resolves or escalates. Most exceptions are handled on the spot. Genuine decisions that belong to you, such as a refund above a limit, come to your nominated person with a clear summary.
  5. Every action is logged, so you can see what the AI did, what the team did and why.
  6. The system improves every month. Patterns in the exceptions become new rules and knowledge, so the AI handles more over time.

The hours-saved guarantee

Before we start, we measure how long the work takes today and agree a realistic hours-saved target with you in writing. If your AI employee hasn’t reached that target within 90 days of going live, we keep working on it at no extra cost until it does. We can offer this because we run the service ourselves and see every exception, so we can fix the causes rather than guess. Full terms are set out in your agreement.

A team that knows your business

Your reviewers aren’t a rotating pool. A small, dedicated group is assigned to your account and trained on your services, clients, policies and tone of voice. They work from a written playbook we build with you, and they learn the context that generic backup services miss: which clients get priority, which requests need your sign-off, and which questions have a standard answer.

The team is managed from Melbourne, with reviewers working across Australian and Indian time zones so exceptions are covered at every hour, including evenings, weekends and public holidays. When it is evening in Melbourne, it is the working day for part of our team, which is how we provide genuine round-the-clock coverage at small-business prices.

Privacy, transparency and control

Human review means people see some of your business information, so privacy is designed in from the start. We follow the Privacy Act 1988 and the OAIC’s guidance on commercially available AI products. Where reviewers outside Australia may access personal information, we treat it as a cross-border disclosure under Australian Privacy Principle 8, with contractual safeguards, confidentiality agreements, access limited to what each task needs and full logging. If your obligations require it, you can choose Australia-only review.

The model also reflects the “maintain human control” and “test and monitor” practices in the Australian Government’s Guidance for AI Adoption. Customers are told when they are dealing with an AI assistant, and they can always reach a person.

What a typical month looks like

Each month you receive a short report showing the volume of work your AI employee handled, the share completed without human help, the exceptions our team resolved, the items escalated to you, the hours saved against target, and the improvements we made. Over time the share handled by AI rises, and your own team’s involvement falls to the decisions that genuinely need them.

How to start

  1. Free AI audit: we find the job with the best payback for your first AI employee.
  2. Playbook and target: we document the rules, escalation points and hours-saved target together.
  3. Build and train: we build the AI employee and train your dedicated reviewers, usually two to four weeks.
  4. Supervised launch: the team checks output closely in the first weeks.
  5. Run and improve: one fixed monthly fee in AUD, monthly reporting and continuous improvement.

Want to see the AI side in action first? Describe a task to the live agent on our homepage, or check your readiness with the free AI readiness check.
faqs: What is the difference between an AI employee and an AI agent?

An AI agent is the technology. An AI employee is that agent set up to do a defined job in your business, with clear rules, a playbook and, at Crenosoft, a dedicated human team that reviews its exceptions and keeps improving it.

A small team of trained Crenosoft reviewers assigned to your account. They learn your services, clients and policies, resolve most exceptions directly and escalate genuine business decisions to your nominated person.
Are the human reviewers in Australia?

The service is managed from Melbourne, with reviewers across Australian and Indian time zones to cover every hour. Overseas access is handled under Australian Privacy Principle 8 with contractual safeguards, and Australia-only review is available if you need it.
How does the hours-saved guarantee work?

We measure the current workload, agree a realistic hours-saved target in writing, and track it monthly. If the target isn’t met within 90 days of going live, we keep working on it at no extra cost until it is. Full terms are in your agreement.
How much does an AI employee cost?

Each AI employee has a one-off set-up fee and one fixed monthly fee in AUD that covers the AI, hosting, human review and improvements. We quote after a free 30-minute audit, once we know the job and volumes.
